Class BlackjackGame

java.lang.Object
BlackjackGame
public class BlackjackGame extends Object
The BlackjackGame is where the mechanics of the game is played. The Player and Dealer objects are created within the BlackjackGame constructor There are 10 methods with this class that contribute to the flow of the game Methods and variables are private to keep the values and functions within the Class Except for what is needed to start the game: BlackjackGame() and start()

    void
    start()
    start() is the flow of the BlackjackGame The game will start and run until the balance within the player subclass Bank is 0 Each round start will reset the player and dealer hands and the stay flags for both objects The flow would be of getting the first 2 cards, hit or staying, handling wins/losses/pushes After each win/loss/push the player will be prompted if they would like to continue

    • start

      public void start()
      start() is the flow of the BlackjackGame The game will start and run until the balance within the player subclass Bank is 0 Each round start will reset the player and dealer hands and the stay flags for both objects The flow would be of getting the first 2 cards, hit or staying, handling wins/losses/pushes After each win/loss/push the player will be prompted if they would like to continue
